item.title: CFCC to host career discovery night for Graphic Design program
item.description: Cape Fear Community College is inviting current and prospective students to a Career Discovery Night for the Graphic Design program.

item.title: Alleged victim speaks out claiming former NHCSO deputy sent inappropriate texts during DV case
item.description: A woman who claims she was harassed by a recently fired New Hanover County Deputy, Dennis McCall, is speaking out about the trauma of that experience.

item.title: Hilton Bluffs master plan reviewed in New Hanover County
item.description: A new update in the ongoing controversial Sledge Forest development, Hilton Bluffs.

item.title: Wilmington Police Department officers train with high-tech drones
item.description: The Wilmington Police Department showed WWAY its new crime-fighting technology on Wednesday.

item.title: From Wilmington to the skies, the Story of George London
item.description: Colonel George London is a retired Test Pilot from Wilmington. His achievements go beyond the skies, as being one of the few black test pilots in the country, and being the first pilot to test fly the C-17 Aircraft.

item.title: Cuba says boat from Florida opened fire at its soldiers, starting fight that killed 4
item.description: Cuba’s government said late Wednesday that the 10 passengers on a boat that opened fire on its soldiers were armed Cubans living in the U.S. who were trying to infiltrate the island and unleash terrorism.

item.title: Justice Department says it’s reviewing whether any Epstein-related records were mistakenly withheld
item.description: The Justice Department said Wednesday that it was looking into whether it had improperly withheld documents from the Jeffrey Epstein files after several news organizations reported that some records involving uncorroborated accusations made by a woman against President Donald Trump were not among those released to the public.

item.title: What to know about the risks of carbon monoxide poisoning after college student’s death
item.description: A Rhode Island college football player died from carbon monoxide poisoning after he tried to charge his phone in his car during a massive snow storm in a power outage.

item.title: First witnesses speak during Craver trial after two days of jury selection
item.description: Prosecutors allege Craver used her position for personal gain, including having an employee assist with dress shopping on county time. Witnesses testified regarding fraudulent timecards, unusual reimbursement requests, and a county-funded laptop used for personal shopping.

item.title: Neighbors shocked as 69-year-old Whiteville woman charged in nearly 50-year-old infant cold case
item.description: In Columbus County, the body of a newborn girl was found in the county landfill, a crime that lay cold for 47 years, until Tuesday, when investigators arrested McKee, charging her with felony concealing the birth of a child.
